source_note: Originals were read from the maintainer's local download folder and copied byte-for-byte. '<source>/' stands for that folder; 'archive.zip!path' means the file was extracted from that archive. Source files were never modified.

categories.cad: STEP parts/assemblies and the Fusion F3D archive
categories.fusion: Fusion 360 script packages (folder and module names fixed by Fusion)
categories.docs: package documentation as delivered, with paths updated
categories.verification: validation records, build reports, BOM/catalogs, sha256sums.txt
categories.reference: electrical reference tables and provenance; hardware envelopes live in fusion/RoverFusion/assets/hardware

exceptions: RoverFusion/ and RoverMotion/ keep their folder, main-script, manifest and module names because Fusion loads scripts by those names
reference/electrical/ELEGOO-Smart-Robot-Car-Kit-V4.0*/README.md and repository_tree.json keep the names written by recover_oem_references.py

recommendation_basis: Latest revision; only family with a completed native Fusion build record (builder 3.0.1, Fusion 2705.1.30) and a complete two-plate sliced X1C print project; its C3 motor interface is derived from the C1 coupon that the project record marks as physically tested. The full V3 chassis itself has not been printed.
